evals.prompt: Break 'Message delivery status — spec' into tickets. The gate passed on the current revision.
evals.expected_output: Ticket 01 prefactor (bind) blocking all others, ACs cite INV-n, quiz before publishing, sub-issues in dependency order.
expectations: Confirms the latest gate record is PASSED and current before slicing
Ticket 01 is the prefactor (prove bind mode) and blocks every other ticket
Each ticket's acceptance criteria cite INV-n ids
Shows a coverage table INV-n to ticket
Quizzes the human and does not publish before approval
Publishes in dependency order as sub-issues of the spec

evals.prompt: Slice the 'Order refunds — spec' into issues.
evals.expected_output: Spec is level A without a current gate record: refuses to slice, routes to prove.
expectations: Detects the spec is level A without a current passed gate record
Routes to prove (gate mode) and says why

evals.prompt: Make tickets for the CSV export spec (level B).
evals.expected_output: Prefactor with property tests for PROP-n first, vertical slices, quiz, publish.
expectations: Ticket 01 adds the PBT library and one property test per PROP-n (pending where unbuilt)
Remaining tickets are vertical slices citing PROP-n
No TLA+ or formal gate is required
